narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Urban Legend Examples -> Debunking/Source Citation -> Conclusion/Questioning.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to explore the origins of popular Taiwanese urban legends regarding buildings allegedly constructed on former Japanese-era execution grounds. It uses the famous Grand Hyatt Taipei ghost story as a primary example before referencing a specific book on urban folklore to suggest these claims may be historically inaccurate. The content is designed to educate and intrigue the audience while promoting the full-length channel content.
